title: Neutron stars spin incredibly fast, up to hundreds of times per second.
purpose: Introduce rapid rotation as a key characteristic.
narration: Neutron stars are the fastest spinning objects in the universe. They can rotate hundreds of times per second. This incredible speed comes from the collapse of a massive star's core. The spin is a key characteristic of these exotic objects.
